lxc_045c3cebd21d7f6a.text: It is due to come out on 19 November 2026.

lxc_ca2e783ae8bd9b6d.text: Grand Theft Auto VI belongs to the Grand Theft Auto series.

lxc_87bf5632c60129f0.text: A series is a group of games with the same main name.

lxc_7faf845da7d9ee35.text: This is the eighth main game in the series.

lxc_cde5cdfde28e923c.text: It follows Grand Theft Auto V, which came out in 2013.

lxc_9fd41fa63b3486a0.text: Rockstar Games makes and publishes the new game.

lxc_475a535ae65155ba.text: This means it creates the game and brings it to players.

lxc_84923872159996d3.text: Rockstar Games is an American video game company.

lxc_8b7336eab3ac0d4c.text: It started in 1998 and is based in New York City.

lxc_f0c20c7b0bf35b76.text: The company is also known for the Red Dead Redemption series.

lxc_664ee10a1fd3be2a.text: The game takes place in Leonida.

lxc_53a7f753f58758c1.text: Leonida is a made-up US state based on Florida.

lxc_e6c7167919bd5d56.text: “Based on” means that a real place gives ideas for a made-up place.

lxc_506aa895cca9eb08.text: Leonida is not another name for the real state.

lxc_35bf09a62dd49408.text: The game's world includes Vice City.

lxc_4abd0a323c3664ae.text: This made-up city is based on Miami, a real city in Florida.

lxc_05bdc22a401ee7d3.text: Think of these places at two different sizes.

lxc_88828602f87f09de.text: Leonida is the state, and Vice City is a city inside it.

lxc_73f2843f981f54c5.text: The game has an open world.

lxc_b67fc28a09510dbb.text: Players can explore its setting rather than only follow one fixed path.

lxc_d39d87fb559059e1.text: The two main characters are Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval.

lxc_59ee5e8871c7a2a1.text: Main characters are the people at the centre of a story.

lxc_9cc201ad55b8ad87.text: Their names often become important when people talk about a game.

lxc_19b0d36c7bce58ff.text: Lucia is the Grand Theft Auto series' first main female character.

lxc_ba2c8d7db124e221.text: The new game has two main characters, while Grand Theft Auto V has three: Michael, Franklin and Trevor.

lxc_99289115bad5e21f.text: This gives us one clear difference between the games.

lxc_771a336f0bb3d8a2.text: Grand Theft Auto VI is also a single-player game.

lxc_0d03ccecb52938ee.text: That means one person plays, even though the story has two main characters.

lxc_7c63dbad602e4a3c.text: Grand Theft Auto V is set in Los Santos, a city based on Los Angeles.

lxc_448ad3c9f9b7c9a3.text: Grand Theft Auto VI changes the setting to Leonida and Vice City.

lxc_bf55f37813a7df5c.text: Its map is reported to be three times larger than the area in Red Dead Redemption 2.

lxc_96cb7fda39ccf47e.text: This size comparison is with that game, not with Grand Theft Auto V.

lxc_f1983ff03918e4cf.text: Activities include skydiving, basketball and scuba diving.

lxc_a17a34c127d58f76.text: There is also a phone social media app called Snapmatic.

lxc_164599837d9d745d.text: The radio offers pop, country, hip-hop and Latin music, plus podcasts.

lxc_1cb9f064318aef21.text: These features give players different things to do and hear while exploring.

lxc_4c8b257bed0129fd.text: A trailer is a short video that gives people an early look at a game.

lxc_432ceb1d5479a25f.text: Grand Theft Auto VI's first trailer came out in December 2023.

lxc_3dd29956bd44393b.text: The second came out in May 2025.

lxc_e4c4dddc9938ee14.text: Both appeared before the game's planned release.

lxc_fa1a1cd7e2b8b6c1.text: The second trailer received a record 475 million views in 24 hours.

lxc_c73ee7d910fdf2d2.text: That is almost half a billion views in one day.

lxc_cf2b793e9b059456.text: The number describes views, not the number of different people who watched.

lxc_d35df310d66d1acb.text: A view count shows how often a video was watched.

lxc_bc3121287f7a7140.text: It does not tell us what every viewer thought about it.

lxc_ec2e2469a1b277a2.text: Grand Theft Auto VI is due to come out on 19 November 2026.

lxc_88c9eab5af3fed6a.text: Rockstar Games' official page gives this date.

lxc_07f958343f2e0422.text: A delay means that something happens later than first planned.

lxc_478cc6028d67390b.text: The announced platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

lxc_97d99139f03e9fc5.text: A platform is the system that a game runs on.

lxc_ccc58fb5dda8e7c2.text: No PC version has been announced.

lxc_c1c453afbbd24ba3.text: That is different from saying a PC version will never exist.

lxc_fa6c993bf04e7e14.text: For now, the announced release is for those consoles, and the release date is still in the future.
